semantics.empty_slot: Source blank/nothing IDs are represented as none for empty item/move slots, not canonical entities.
semantics.items_abilities_spreads_tera_types: Each category's weighted count / its own category total.
semantics.missing_tera_types: null means the source did not supply this category.
semantics.moves: Weighted move count / total ability weight; named moves are marginal inclusion frequencies, so sums may approach 4; none counts empty move slots and may exceed 1.
semantics.usage_fraction: Source usage fraction, not a role probability; source's weighted team usage statistic.
semantics.zero_total: Empty distributions; no division or fabricated probabilities.
